diagnosis: The central Guide compiler expected job.returns and job.collisions to drive RETURNS_UNCONSUMED, PARTIAL_LOOP and collision-pressure roles, while build-live-feed intentionally stripped those full arrays from feed.projects before publication. As a result, nonterminal PARTIAL/BOUNDARY evidence and collision evidence disappeared from the compiler input after compaction, and LOW_YIELD detection leaned disproportionately on generic replaceable/recovery pressure.
intervention: Restored the missing cable without republishing full authority histories. Live now emits at most three compact recent return refs and three compact recent collision refs per job, including outcome/time only; the allocator consumes these bounded fields with fallback compatibility, preserves PARTIAL/BOUNDARY/ROUTE_ABORTED attention for non-done jobs, and limits collision pressure to a 30-minute window. Added EFF022, a regression test proving compact returns -> GUIDE_INTEGRATOR, compact PARTIAL/BOUNDARY -> GUIDE_CRITIC, recent collisions -> GUIDE_RESCATE, and old collision evidence does not create permanent pressure; wired the test into live-feed publication and the central ratchet checker.

tests.summary: Current main preserves compact evidence limits, strips full histories, consumes compact evidence in the allocator, binds 30-minute collision pressure, includes EFF022, workflow guard and central checker guard.

The published live feed and allocator at source_sha 1737f600df9d1d8fe6e5c6481451bec60b9f75fb contain the compact role-signal fields; allocator metabolism reports unconsumed_returns=12 and role_ready now includes GUIDE_INTEGRATOR and GUIDE_CRITIC from durable return/attention evidence. The same workflow source includes role_signal_compaction_v1.mjs before publication, so reaching the publish stage is bounded runtime evidence that the guard passed for that source.

remaining_boundary: No direct GitHub Actions run ID was available from the connector, so the runtime claim is bounded to successful post-guard gh-pages publication, not a separately inspected run log. Issue #22 telemetry comments remain unavailable through the connector path used by this worker; GitHub PINs/receipts remain authority.
expected_multiplicative_effect: Guide role selection can again react to the actual recent return/collision evidence that caused work to stall, while Live remains compact. This reduces blind recovery churn, restores Integrator/Critic routing for aged nonterminal work, and prevents historical collision evidence from generating permanent rescue pressure.
